name: fruitback
description: Visual feedback that plants annotations on a live page and grows them into issues in the tracker you already run — embedded in the site, or brought to it by a browser extension.

scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; pnpm --filter @fruitback/worker dev:pglite & pnpm --filter @fruitback/playground dev; wait'
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @fruitback/shared build && pnpm --filter @fruitback/widget build && pnpm --filter @fruitback/element build && WXT_FRUITBACK_CLOUD=http://localhost:8789 pnpm --filter @fruitback/extension build && pnpm --filter @fruitback/extension build:firefox && playwright test
scripts.e2e:ui: pnpm --filter @fruitback/shared build && pnpm --filter @fruitback/widget build && WXT_FRUITBACK_CLOUD=http://localhost:8789 pnpm --filter @fruitback/extension build && playwright test --ui
scripts.ext:bench: pnpm --filter @fruitback/shared build && pnpm --filter @fruitback/widget build && pnpm --filter @fruitback/extension build && node e2e/bench.ts
